note: 14 lewisian assets per docs/imagery/DEDUCTION.md §5.1. JSON (not YAML) so the pipeline needs only stdlib + Pillow. Bump an asset's `v` and edit `brief` together when a prompt changes materially — the new client_request_id retires the old cell.

assets.title: Cover: The Widow's Lamp
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash plate: a rain-swept dockside street at dusk, crooked timber tenements leaning into the wind, and one narrow three-story tenement whose single ground-floor window glows with steady amber lamplight.
assets.brief: A rain-swept dockside street at dusk: crooked three-story tenements of dark timber lean into the wind on wet cobblestones, and in the narrowest tenement a single ground-floor window glows with steady warm amber lamplight; a small wooden sign swings from one chain over its door; no people in the street, no patrol lanterns, sheets of rain, slate grey-blue storm light — the one amber window is the painting's single small pale-gold light point; quiet, stubborn hope in a storm.

assets.title: Cover: The Roof of Mercy
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash plate: a crowded two-story clay-tiled house in a small courtyard, townsfolk pressing at the door, while four young men on the clay-tile roof pry up tiles and hoist a stretcher by ropes.
assets.brief: A modest two-story clay-tiled house in a small hill-town courtyard on a bright autumn morning, its shutters thrown wide; a dense crowd of townsfolk in simple homespun presses shoulder-to-shoulder at its door and windows and spills into the yard; on the clay-tile roof four young men kneel, prying up tiles and hoisting a rope-slung stretcher up from the crowd's edge; every figure small within the scene, soft morning light, hopeful hush — the sun-break over the roofline is the single small pale-gold light point.

assets.title: Handout plate: The Collector's Letter
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash still life: a folded vellum letter sealed with black wax, a plain coin pressed into the seal instead of a signet, an iron-grey quill beside it on a dark oak table.
assets.brief: Still life on a dark oak table: a folded vellum letter sealed with a blob of black wax into which a plain dull coin has been pressed instead of a signet, an iron-grey quill laid beside it; the vellum's writing is turned away from the viewer so no lettering shows — only the wax, the coin, and the fold cast long shadows in cold slate window light; legalistic, wintry, quietly menacing.

assets.title: Handout plate: Mara's Journal
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash still life: a slim water-stained notebook with warped pages on a rain-spotted windowsill, beside a small brass oil lamp burning with one steady pale-gold flame.
assets.brief: Still life on a rain-spotted wooden windowsill: a slim water-stained notebook with a worn cloth cover, its warped pages showing only blurred illegible pen-strokes from old water damage; beside it a small brass oil lamp burns with one steady pale-gold flame; warm cream-paper tones, patient and tender — the lamp flame is the single small pale-gold light point.

assets.title: Handout plate: The Paralytic's Prayer
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash still life: a crumpled vellum sheet smoothed flat by years of folding, covered in faded sepia pen-lines, lying on a plain wooden table under soft morning light from a torn roof opening.
assets.brief: Still life: a crumpled piece of vellum, smoothed flat by years of folding and unfolding, its old sepia writing faded by water and time into flowing wavy horizontal lines, dashes and blurred smudges — strictly no letterforms, no word shapes, no cursive, no legible characters of any kind, the marks read as abstract stains at a glance; it lies on a plain wooden table beneath a shaft of soft morning light falling through a torn-open clay roof above, dust motes in the beam; gentle, hopeful, deeply worn — the light shaft is the single small pale-gold light point.

assets.title: Token: Widow Mara
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash portrait vignette of Widow Mara: an elderly dock-ward woman in a dark kerchief and worn moss-green shawl, one thin hand on a wooden cane, kind but sharp eyes.
assets.brief: Head-and-shoulders portrait vignette on cream paper: an elderly dock-ward widow, a thin weathered face, wispy grey hair under a plain dark kerchief, a worn moss-green woolen shawl, kind but sharp eyes that have outlasted fear, one thin hand resting on a plain wooden cane; fragile but unbowed.

assets.title: Token: The Lamplighter
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash portrait vignette of the Lamplighter: a gentle ageless face deep in the hood of an oilskin cloak, holding a tall brass lantern staff whose small lamp burns pale gold.
assets.brief: Head-and-shoulders portrait vignette on cream paper: a mysterious timeless lamplighter, a gentle ageless face deep in the hood of a rain-dark oilskin cloak, calm watchful eyes, holding a tall brass-poled lantern staff whose small lamp burns with one steady pale-gold flame; humble and quiet, half in dusk-blue shadow — the staff lamp is the single small pale-gold light point; no wings, no halo, majesty kept quiet.

assets.title: Token: Debt Collector of the Iron Ledger
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash portrait vignette of the Debt Collector: a gaunt figure in a severe charcoal greatcoat, face hidden behind a smooth featureless iron mask, a chain-bound black ledger clutched to its chest.
assets.brief: Head-and-shoulders portrait vignette on cream paper: an infernal debt-collector, a gaunt figure in a severe charcoal greatcoat of legalist cut, the face wholly hidden behind a smooth featureless iron mask, a heavy chain-bound black ledger clutched to the chest; cold slate-grey register, menacing through bureaucracy and procedure — never gore, no occult symbols.

assets.title: Token: Thug (reusable)
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash portrait vignette of a dock-ward thug: a heavyset enforcer in a patched oilcloth coat and sodden flat cap, heavy gloves, sullen jaw, rain on his shoulders.
assets.brief: Head-and-shoulders portrait vignette on cream paper: a dock-ward thug, a heavyset human enforcer in a patched oilcloth coat and a sodden flat cap pulled low, heavy gloves, a sullen jaw and small hard eyes, rain beading on his shoulders; brutish but ordinary — a man hired for coin, not a monster.

assets.title: Token: Wandering Teacher (rear/distant)
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash vignette of the Wandering Teacher seen from behind at a distance: weathered sand-colored robes, mid-gesture, the backs of a listening crowd's heads in the foreground.
assets.brief: A traveling teacher seen from behind and at a little distance, mid-gesture as he addresses a crowd: weathered sand-colored robes, dust on the hem, simple worn sandals; the backs of the listening crowd's heads soft in the foreground; his face is never visible — authority carried by posture and by the crowd's utter attention, morning light around him.

assets.title: Token: Paralytic Elian
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash portrait vignette of Elian: a young man on a woven stretcher mat, propped on one elbow, lower body still beneath a homespun blanket, face lifted and bright-eyed with hope.
assets.brief: Low portrait vignette on cream paper: a young man lying on a woven stretcher mat, propped on one elbow, his lower body still beneath a plain homespun blanket, his face lifted and bright-eyed with a hope that has outlasted years of closed doors, travel-worn cloak; four friends' hands grip the stretcher corners just at the frame's edge; dignified, never pitiable.

assets.title: Token: Temple Scribe (reusable)
assets.alt: Storybook ink-and-wash portrait vignette of a Temple Scribe: layered grey-brown ceremonial robes with a formal sash, arms folded across a writing board, scroll case at the hip, a pursed disapproving expression.
assets.brief: Head-and-shoulders portrait vignette on cream paper: an officious temple scribe in layered grey-brown ceremonial robes with a formal sash, arms folded across a wooden writing board, a scroll case at his hip, a pursed disapproving mouth and narrowed measuring eyes; rigid and procedural, a gatekeeper of proper channels — officious, not wicked.

assets.title: Vista: Dock Ward in rain (scene 1)
assets.alt: Wide storybook ink-and-wash vista: a rain-soaked dock ward at dusk, slate-grey sheets of rain over dark cobblestones and crooked timber tenements, one narrow tenement's ground-floor window glowing steady amber.
assets.brief: Wide establishing plate of a rain-soaked dock ward at dusk: slate grey-blue sheets of rain over dark cobblestones and crooked timber tenements, one narrow three-story tenement leaning into the wind with a single ground-floor window glowing steady amber, a small sign swinging from one chain above its door, empty street, far harbor masts lost in the gloom; mood of stubborn hope in a storm — the amber window is the single small pale-gold light point.

assets.title: Vista: The courtyard house (scene 1)
assets.alt: Wide storybook ink-and-wash vista: a modest two-story clay-tiled house in a hill-town courtyard on an autumn morning, a dense crowd pressing at its open door, a stretcher bearing a still figure at the crowd's edge.
assets.brief: Wide establishing plate of a small courtyard in a hill town on an autumn morning: a modest two-story clay-tiled house with shutters thrown wide, a dense crowd in plain homespun pressing shoulder-to-shoulder at its door and spilling into the yard, every face turned toward the doorway in attentive hush; at the crowd's edge a stretcher bears a still figure whose eyes are bright; soft golden morning light breaking over the roofline is the single small pale-gold light point; the air hums with attention.
